scheduler.heading: Scheduler
scheduler.hint: The scheduler aims to show each card just before you'd forget it. A higher recall target means more reviews and stronger retention; a lower target means fewer reviews and a bit more forgetting. Most people leave this at 90%.

masteryThreshold.label: Mastery threshold
masteryThreshold.description: Cards with this many consecutive correct reviews count as mastered.

recallTarget.label: Recall target ({percent}%)
recallTarget.description: Lower means fewer reviews but you will forget more cards. Higher means more reviews but better retention. Default 90%.

quickstart.heading: Quickstart
quickstart.label: Mark Pokémon I already know
quickstart.description: Tap the Pokémon you already recognise. Each one graduates straight into the scheduler with a long first interval, so you can skip the new-card queue for species you know cold.

newPerDay.label: New cards per day
newPerDay.description: Hard daily cap. Raising this grows tomorrow's review pile faster.

reviewsPerDay.label: Reviews per day
reviewsPerDay.description: Soft cap; you can always override it during a session.

typedEntry.label: Verified typed entry for name cards
typedEntry.description: Type the name instead of grading yourself. Grades are decided automatically based on how close your answer is.
typedEntry.mcRampNote: New cards start as multiple choice during the learning phase. Once a card has been reviewed enough times to graduate, it switches to verified typed entry.
typedEntry.bannerText: Verified typed entry is on. New cards will show multiple choice for the first few reviews. Once a card graduates into long-term review, you will be asked to type the name.

evolutionCards.heading: Evolution cards
evolutionCards.enableDescription: Show sprite; identify the evolution chain. Disabling hides these cards without losing your progress.

newPerDay.label: New cards per day
newPerDay.description: Hard daily cap for evolution cards. Tracked separately from name cards.

reviewsPerDay.label: Reviews per day
reviewsPerDay.description: Soft cap for evolution reviews. Independent of the name-card review cap.

reverseEvolutionCards.heading: Reverse-evolution cards
reverseEvolutionCards.enableDescription: Quiz the opposite direction of evolution edges ("Which Pokémon evolves into X via Y?"). Shares the same daily new/review budget as forward evolution cards. Disabling hides these cards without losing your progress.

alternateForms.heading: Alternate forms
alternateForms.enableDescription: Regional forms, Megas and other variants. Off by default: the base Pokédex is already a large deck.

newPerDay.label: New cards per day
newPerDay.description: Hard daily cap for reverse cards. Tracked separately from name cards.

reviewsPerDay.label: Reviews per day
reviewsPerDay.description: Soft cap for reverse reviews. Independent of the name-card review cap.

cryCards.heading: Cry → name cards
cryCards.enableDescription: Audio prompt: hear the cry and name the Pokémon. Species without a cry are skipped automatically. Disabling hides these cards without losing your progress.

playCryOnReveal.label: Play cry on reveal
playCryOnReveal.description: Plays the Pokémon's cry once when you reveal a name or evolution card, and when you answer a reverse (sprite-picker) card.

speakNameOnReveal.label: Speak name on reveal
speakNameOnReveal.description: Reads the Pokémon's name aloud using your device's text-to-speech engine when you reveal a card. British English voice preferred.

waitForAudio.label: Wait for audio before next card
waitForAudio.description: When on (default), the next card waits until the cry and spoken name finish before appearing. Turn off for a faster swap: audio continues playing under the next card and is not cut off.

reverseFeedbackDelay.label: Reverse card feedback delay
reverseFeedbackDelay.description: How long the sprite picker lingers on the correct or incorrect highlight before advancing to the next card. Off: no pause. Fast: 250 ms correct / 500 ms incorrect. Default: 600 ms / 1200 ms.

backup.heading: Backup
backup.exportDescription: Downloads a JSON backup of all your card progress and settings.
backup.downloadReviewHistoryDescription: Downloads your full review history as a CSV file (date, Pokémon, card type, grade). Useful for personal analysis and satisfies GDPR data portability.
backup.importDescription: Restore from a previously exported backup. Replaces current progress after confirmation.

howThisWorks.heading: How this works
howThisWorks.body1: Poké Memory uses <link>FSRS</link>, a spaced-repetition scheduler that picks the best time to show each card based on how well you remember it.
howThisWorks.body2: After every grade the scheduler updates its model of how strong your memory of that card is, and sets the next review for when you're most likely to be about to forget it. Forgetting and then re-remembering is what actually moves a card into long-term memory, so getting a few Agains is normal and part of the system working.
howThisWorks.body3: Honest grading matters more than getting every card right. If you almost forgot, press Hard. If you truly forgot, press Again. The scheduler can't help you if you mark cards Easy when you only just scraped it.
howThisWorks.showOnboardingAgainDescription: Re-opens the welcome guide on the Practice page and restores contextual hints on Stats and Settings.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: Used for daily review limits and streak roll-overs. Auto-detected on first load.

dateFormat.label: Date format
dateFormat.description: Controls how dates are shown throughout the app. Live preview updates below.

dailyReminderTime.label: Daily reminder time
dailyReminderTime.description: Preferred local hour for your daily practice reminder. Uses your timezone above. Full per-hour delivery activates after a scheduled update.

about.heading: About
about.whatsNewDescription: See what shipped in recent releases.

dangerZone.heading: Danger zone
dangerZone.resetDescriptionCloud: Permanently deletes your review history and cloud data.
dangerZone.deleteDescription: Permanently erases your account, cloud data, and sign-in identity. This cannot be undone.
dangerZone.deletePausedTitle: Account deletion is paused while a superuser flag is on.

developer.heading: Developer
developer.description: QA shortcuts. While any flag here is on, sync to the cloud is paused so QA state can't leak into your real data. Turning off the last flag (or locking superuser mode) restores cloud state for signed-in users, or offers to reset local state for guests.

pretendAllMastered.label: Pretend all Pokémon are mastered
pretendAllMastered.description: Renders every species as mastered across the Pokédex, detail pages, Pasture, Stats, and the theme picker.

forceNextStreakMilestone.label: Force next streak milestone
forceNextStreakMilestone.description: Fires the smallest un-seen streak celebration on the next visit to Practice, regardless of the real streak. Self-clears after one fire. Locking superuser overwrites local progress with cloud state for signed-in users.

forceCardsGraduated.label: Force cards graduated
forceCardsGraduated.description: Treat all cards as graduated. Use to test typed entry without grinding learning steps.

qaSeedMode.label: QA seed mode
qaSeedMode.description: Reveals a scenario picker to inject test data into local storage. Local-only: sync is paused so seeded data cannot reach the cloud.

resetEarnedBadges.label: Reset earned badges
resetEarnedBadges.description: Clears your gym-badge list so you can re-trigger the reveal toasts. Local-only while superuser is on.

developer.themeAuditDescription: Side-by-side preview of every mascot × intensity × colour scheme. Use when tweaking globals.css to spot combos where the grade buttons blend into the surface.

masteryMeaning.title: What "mastered" means
masteryMeaning.body: A card is mastered once you've recalled it correctly {reps} {reps, plural, one {time} other {times}} in a row and the next review is scheduled at least 21 days out: that's when the scheduler is confident you've actually learnt it, not just memorised it short term.

onboarding.intro: Learn every Pokémon name and evolution with spaced repetition. New cards arrive daily; the app surfaces each card right before you would likely forget it, so gaps grow as your memory strengthens.

howToGrade.heading: How to grade
howToGrade.good: <term>Good</term> - you recalled it with some effort.
howToGrade.honestGradeNote: Grade honestly. Hitting Again sometimes is normal and part of the system working; the scheduler only improves if you tell it the truth.

addingSound.heading: Adding sound (optional)
addingSound.body: You can enable Pokémon cries on card reveal and spoken names via text-to-speech. You can also unlock cry cards, where the audio is the prompt.

guestStorage.heading: Your progress is saved on this device
guestStorage.body: Progress is stored in your browser and is not backed up automatically. On iOS Safari, the browser may clear it after 7 days without a visit. To keep it safe: add this page to your Home Screen, or sign in to back it up to the cloud.
